# Support

_Core Hermit. Effective October 9, 2026._

## Get help
Email **wavypix@gmail.com** with the subject "Longstead Support". Or, if you are a TestFlight tester, use **Share Beta Feedback** (it includes a screenshot and device details automatically).

In the app, **Settings** has the legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, AI Disclaimer) with a link to this support address.

## What to include
- The app version and build (for example 1.0.0 (1); shown at the bottom of Settings), iPhone or Mac model, and iOS or macOS version.
- Which AI engine you were using (Apple Intelligence, or a downloaded model such as Qwen3.5 4B).
- What you did, what you expected, and what happened. A screenshot helps.
- For a number that looks wrong: your filing status, state, year, and the amounts you entered. Please use made-up numbers if you can; do not send account numbers, Social Security numbers, or passwords. We will never ask for them.

We do not receive crash reports or analytics from the app, so we only know about problems you tell us about (or that Apple's TestFlight passes along if you opt in).

## Response expectations
This is a small independent team. We aim to reply within **3 business days** and to fix confirmed bugs in a future update. We cannot give financial, tax, or legal advice, and cannot recover data from your device (the app keeps your data only there, and excludes it from backups, so export plans regularly).

## Self-help
- **User guide:** [Documentation/user/USER_GUIDE.md](../user/USER_GUIDE.md) and the [Quick Start](../user/QUICK_START.md) in the repository.
- **Installation:** [Documentation/INSTALLATION.md](../INSTALLATION.md)
- **No AI response:** Apple Intelligence must be available and turned on to use Apple's model. On devices without it, download a model in Settings (Wi-Fi recommended).
- **Delete your data:** Settings > Your data > Erase all data.
- **Moving or backing up a plan:** Profile > Plan management > Export plan. The file is unencrypted; keep it somewhere safe.
- **Model download fails:** check your connection and free storage, then retry. Models range from about 1.7 GB on iPhone up to about 20 GB on Macs with 48 GB or more of memory; the app only lists models that fit your device.
- **The Mac app will not open:** use the latest notarized download, macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. Follow the Gatekeeper steps on the download page.
- **Numbers look wrong:** re-check your inputs, state, and year. State tax data covers nine states for 2025 only (see the Financial Disclaimer).

## Security issues
Please follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Privacy requests
See the Privacy Policy. We hold no personal data collected through the app; emails you send us are used only to reply.
